title: OpCredit: Operation-Aware Policy Learning for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.21345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering(KGQA) relies on sequences of executable operations, but trajectory-level rewards obscure their individual contributions. Successful trajectories may contain ineffective operations, while failed trajectories may contain useful ones. To assess individual operations, we propose OpCredit, an operationaware policy-learning framework that combines downstream outcome credit with immediate transition credit: Branch Outcome Credit (BOC) reuses ordinary rollouts to compare terminal task rewards observed after different operations under matched navigation contexts; Frontier Transition Credit (FTC) measures operation-induced changes in answer-conditioned frontier potential. The two complementary signals jointly supervise the corresponding decision spans during training, while inference uses only the learned policy and standard KG interface. translated_title: OpCredit：面向智能体知识图谱问答的操作感知策略学习
translated_abstract: 智能体知识图谱问答（KGQA）依赖于可执行的操作序列，但轨迹级别的奖励掩盖了各个操作的独立贡献。成功的轨迹中可能包含无效的操作，而失败的轨迹中也可能包含有用的操作。为了评估单个操作，我们提出了 OpCredit，这是一个操作感知的策略学习框架，它将下游结果信用与即时转移信用相结合：分支结果信用（BOC）通过复用普通 rollout，在匹配的导航上下文下比较不同操作之后观察到的终端任务奖励；前沿转移信用（FTC）衡量操作所引起的以答案为条件的前沿势能变化。这两种互补的信号在训练期间共同监督相应的决策片段，而推理阶段仅使用学习到的策略和标准的知识图谱接口。在 ComplexWebQuestions、WebQSP 和 GrailQA 上跨三个……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: OpCredit 通过结合分支结果信用与前沿转移信用两种互补信号，为智能体知识图谱问答中的每个操作实现精细化信用分配，从而提升操作感知的策略学习效果。
en_tdlr: OpCredit is an operation-aware policy learning framework for agentic KGQA that assigns credit to individual operations by combining Branch Outcome Credit with Frontier Transition Credit, two complementary signals that jointly supervise decision spans during training.
